prose: Mirendil introduced Fern, its first model, pretrained from scratch with a context window of up to 10M tokens. The first version, Fern 0.1, received a short round of post-training, and the company says new versions will ship frequently. It positions Fern as its most efficient model, built for focused, high-volume agentic tasks.
highlights: Fern is Mirendil's first model, pretrained from scratch
Positioned for high-volume agentic tasks; frequent new versions promised
basis: The extracted cache held under 400 characters, so this entry is based on that short announcement.
